 Home / Education / News / CBSE board exams 2027: Class 10, 12 datesheet released, check key dates CBSE board exams 2027: Class 10, 12 datesheet released, check key dates
 CBSE has officially declared the Class 10 and Class 12 board exam 2027 datesheet. The board exams 2027 will start from Feb 16 to Apr 9, 2027. Check complete timetable on official website
 CBSE Class 10, 12 Datesheet 2027
 Princess Sonika New Delhi 18 min read Last Updated : Nov 09 2026 | 4:49 PM IST The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the Class 10 and Class 12 board examination timetable for 2027. Students can access the full timetable in PDF format through the official website, cbse.gov. in.    Around 46.3 lakh candidates are expected to appear for the examinations in 2027. Of these, approximately 26.5 lakh are from Class 10 and 19.8 lakh from Class 12. Class 10 students account for around 57 per cent of the total candidates, while Class 12 students make up the remaining 43 per cent.   The datesheet applies to CBSE-affiliated schools in India and abroad. No examination has been scheduled on a Sunday.   CBSE Board Exam 2027: Important Dates
 Practical Exams / Internal Assessment- 1 January to 13 February 2027   Theory Exams start- 16 February 2027 (Tuesday) Also Read

   Class 10 exams end- 9 March 2027   Class 12 exams end- 9 April 2027.    ALSO READ:  WB HS 3rd Semester Final Answer Key 2027 PDF released, check details How to download CBSE Date Sheet 2027?
 Visit the official website at cbse.gov.in   Click on the "Latest Updates" section on the home page   Choose the link for "Date Sheet Class 10 & 12 Board Examination 2027"   The date sheet PDF will displayed on the screen   Download the PDF and take a printout for later reference.  CBSE Board Exam Date 2027 Class 10
 The CBSE Class 10 Board Exams 2027 will start on February 16, 2027 (Tuesday) and will conclude on March 9, 2027. Maths is planned for February 17, the second day of the exams. All papers will begin at 10:30 AM.    The exams will be conducted over 19 exam days within 22 calendar days, covering 83 subject papers. About 26.5 lakh students will show up.
